# Mini Racer

> A daily time trial. Same track for everyone, new one at midnight UTC.

Site: https://miniracer.club/
Community: https://www.reddit.com/r/MiniRacerGame/

## Driving

The throttle is automatic. You hold left or right — A and D, the arrow keys, or either side of the
screen. Walls slow you down; they do not end the lap. Most laps run under a minute.

## Modes

- Daily: everyone races the same track. It changes at midnight UTC and the last seven days stay open,
  each with its own board.
- Campaign: Stages that do not expire. Each stage carries Bronze, Silver, Gold and Author target
  times; beating one takes that medal, and medals unlock the next stage. Half Life's Author time is
  11.27 seconds.
- Head to Head: race someone's saved run as a ghost until you beat it.

## Times

The server replays your steering before a time counts, and ranks it to the millisecond. Your best lap
comes back as a ghost, and you can chase anyone else's the same way.

## Content

Hand-built tracks. 23 cars and 8 trails, which change how you look and nothing else. Built on
Devvit, Reddit's developer platform.

## Pages

- [Home](https://miniracer.club/): the game summary, the modes, and play links.
